until: should be calibrated with respect to structural data
statement: Three steps: (1) map heavy atoms to R (4:1), S (3:1) or T (2:1) beads by chemical group; (2) type each bead from Supplementary Tables 24/25, or from the partitioning data of Tables 17-19 when no group matches; (3) bonded terms from atomistic data, bond lengths by the centre-of-geometry rule.

until: symmetry of the original atomistic molecule
statement: Do not divide a chemical group (amide, carboxylate, ...) between beads; avoid under- or over-mapping; keep volume, shape and symmetry of the atomistic molecule.

find: Default mapping of linear and ring
statement: Only heavy atoms define the mapping. 4:1, 3:1 and 2:1 groups are R, S and T beads. T beads suit flat aromatic rings, S beads bulkier aliphatic rings, R beads flexible 4:1 chains. Mismatch at most +-1 heavy atom per 10 heavy atoms.

Fully branched fragments (quaternary carbon, tertiary amine) may use a smaller bead (neopentane, 5 heavy atoms, as an R bead); for partially branched fragments the full-branching rule risks too little self-interaction.

until: Some choices of chemical bead types for all halogens
statement: Two fluorine atoms count as one heavy atom; each iodine counts as two heavy atoms.
Atoms of the 4th period or higher count as two heavy atoms by default; validate against experiment.

find: Ions and charged groups in general
until: precise definition for the best bead sizes
statement: Localized charged groups on neutral fragments are Q beads; small ions map 1:1 to 7:1; see Table 25 for ion bead sizes and types.
Inductive or conjugation effects of neighbouring groups can shift the type or add the e/v labels; charged neighbours act strongest.
Nearby polar groups change local dipoles and the polarity of the default type; h/r labels tune self-interaction.
Internal hydrogen bonds change donor/acceptor availability (d/a labels) and oil/water transfer.
Resolution matters: in higher-resolution alkane models the terminal beads take C2 and the middle beads C1.
With several proximity effects, take inspiration from existing Martini 3 models.
